'''Stewed bhillen''' was a type of [[Foodstuff/Legends|dish]] made in a pot. The dish could be consumed by [[Human/Legends|Humans]] and was made using [[bhillen]], a type of [[Species/Legends|animal]].<ref name="Slaying Dragons" /> In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> the Human [[Technician/Legends|technician]] [[Deen Voorson]] visited his [[Voorson family|family]] on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Kuat Freight Port]] in the [[Kuat system/Legends|Kuat system]]. While there, the Voorson family gathered around a pot of stewed bhillen and discussed the previous four [[Standard year/Legends|years]] since Deen had last visited.<ref name="Slaying Dragons" />  

==Behind the scenes==
Stewed bhillen appeared in "[[Slaying Dragons]]," a short story written by [[Angela Phillips]] and published by [[West End Games]] in [[February]] [[1996]] in the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 9|ninth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]''.<ref name="Slaying Dragons" />
